```js
const geo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(17.5, 48);
```

Also, the water shader might rely on the geometry’s size for UV calculations; a larger radius could improve the visual quality of the water ripple pattern and make the pond more prominent.

I should verify whether any other parts of the code reference this radius. A quick mental scan: the pond is likely positioned at a fixed location, and its geometry is only used here. Changing the radius from 17.5 to a slightly larger value (e.g., 19.5) will expand the pond without breaking anything else. The segment is not part of a replace‑all block, so I need to target the exact line.

Thus, the next logical step is to edit the CircleGeometry radius to better match the scene scale and improve the pond’s visual impact. I'll issue an Edit call that replaces the old string with the new one, increasing the radius from 17.5 to 19.5 while keeping the segment count (48) unchanged.
